subject: Medicore Health - SSO/SCIM artifact collection for SOC2 review
messages:
From: Elena Fitzgerald <elaine.fitzgerald@auditrust.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicore Security Team <security@medicorehealth.com>, Medicore DPO <dpo@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Medicore - SSO/SCIM artifact request for SOC2 review

Hi Vivek,

Following Medicore's SIG/SOC2 evidence intake, the auditors (Auditrust) need a narrow set of artifacts related to Redwood's identity and provisioning controls. Please provide the following by EOD July 23 if possible:

- SAML metadata and IdP/SP configuration export for production (entityID, certificate, ACS URLs) — prefer XML.
- SCIM provisioning logs (delta syncs) covering 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30 — include timestamps, operation (create/update/delete), user id, source system.
- RBAC role mapping document showing permission sets and role-to-action mapping (app-level and infra-level if applicable).
- Onboarding/offboarding runbook that captures automated and manual steps (including who can trigger provisioning).
- Admin account inventory and current list of privileged accounts.

If you need to redact PII, please indicate what was redacted and why. We prefer attachments, but a shared Drive link with viewer access for Auditrust is fine (expiring link is preferred).

Let me know if this timeline is feasible or if you need a day extension. We can scope down if some items take longer (e.g., full audit log exports).

Thanks,
Elena Fitzgerald
Senior Consultant, Auditrust
elaine.fitzgerald@auditrust.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, elaine.fitzgerald@auditrust.com, Medicore Security Team <security@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Medicore - SSO/SCIM artifact request for SOC2 review

Team — forwarding Auditor request from Auditrust / Medicore. Elena asked for a tight set of artifacts related to SSO/SCIM and RBAC for their SOC2 intake. Deadline EOD 7/23 but we should aim EOD 7/22 to give them time to review.

Quick asks:
- Stephanie — can you assemble SAML metadata, SCIM delta logs for June, and admin account inventory? If SCIM export is large, a filtered delta CSV is ok as long as columns match what they asked for.
- Marissa — can you export the RBAC mapping and onboarding/offboarding runbook? If there are two docs (product-level / infra-level), include both and note which is which.
- Laura — please review for anything that needs redaction and sign off on sharing scope.

Elena — looping Auditrust so they can confirm if they prefer Drive links or attachments.

I'll track. If anything sensitive requires Legal/Escalation, flag it and I'll route.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, elaine.fitzgerald@auditrust.com, Medicore Security Team <security@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medicore - SSO/SCIM artifact request for SOC2 review

Vivek / team — attaching the artifacts we can produce quickly. Summary below and notes on redaction/retention.

Attachments included:
- sso-metadata-20260721.xml (IdP/SP metadata export; certs included)
- scim-delta-sync-20260601-20260630.csv (columns: timestamp, operation, user_id, source, attributes_changed)
- rbac-role-mapping-202607.pdf (high-level mapping; internal-only actions redacted where necessary)
- onboarding-offboarding-runbook-2026-07.pdf (describes automated SCIM paths + manual fallback)
- admin-account-inventory-202607.csv (username, role, last-auth, notes — PII minimized)

Notes:
- SCIM logs: we retain delta syncs for 90 days in raw form; the CSV is an export from the provisioning service filtered to June 2026. If Auditrust needs full raw logs, we can pull them but that'll take ~1 business day.
- Redactions: removed MFA device serials and internal ticket IDs from the admin inventory. We documented redactions in the CSV header.
- Access: artifacts are available in a restricted Drive folder. I've pasted an expiring viewer link below (72h expiry). If Auditrust needs a temporary service account, we can add an auditor group with scoped access.

Drive link (artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink
JIRA ticket: SEC-847 (tracking collection & disclosures)

If anything else is required (SAML logs showing assertion failures, per-user provisioning traces), call me — we can scope a follow-up request.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: sso-metadata-20260721.xml, scim-delta-sync-20260601-20260630.csv, rbac-role-mapping-202607.pdf, onboarding-offboarding-runbook-2026-07.pdf, admin-account-inventory-202607.csv

From: Elena Fitzgerald <elaine.fitzgerald@auditrust.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicore Security Team <security@medicorehealth.com>, Medicore DPO <dpo@medicorehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicore - SSO/SCIM artifact request for SOC2 review

Stephanie / Vivek — thank you, received the attachments and Drive link. A couple quick clarifications so we can mark the CSV ingested: 

1) In the SCIM delta CSV, can you confirm the operation field uses one of: CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE (we saw "delta_create" in a sample row). If so, we can normalize on our side, but please note the mapping in the CSV header.
2) For the admin-account-inventory, can you confirm whether "last-auth" is last successful auth or last activity (including API keys)? The audit requires last successful interactive auth date if available.

If you can reply inline to those two points, we can proceed with ingestion. Otherwise the artifacts look good and we appreciate the quick turnaround.
